ai.title: Hackers exploited iOS and Android flaws to infect phones
ai.brief: Hackers possibly linked to the Kremlin exploited previously patched iOS and Android flaws in an attempt to hack visitors of multiple websites, including one celebrating the 250th anniversary of American independence, researchers said Wednesday. org, belonging to a non-partisan group of lawmakers, business executives, and at least one former member of the Trump administration. org. sec.title: SonicWall Won't Patch EoL GMS Flaws That Could Expose Files, Alter Database Records
sec.brief: SonicWall has warned of two vulnerabilities impacting end-of-life Global Management System (GMS) systems that it said will not be patched. 1) - An unauthenticated file read vulnerability that could allow an attacker with network access to read internal GMS files,
